description:
Cast a copy of Ancestral Recall by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Emeritus of Ideation. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Ancestral Recall, causing a player to draw three cards.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
